Class BookService

java.lang.Object
com.library.service.BookService
public class BookService extends Object
Provides operations for managing books in the library system.

This service interacts with FileStorage to load, save, search, and add books. It ensures that ISBNs remain unique and supports multiple search mechanisms (title, author, ISBN).

All book data is persisted in a text-based storage format.

  • Method Details

    • addBook

      public Book addBook(String title, String author, String isbn)
      Adds a new book to the library.

      ISBNs must be unique. If a book already exists with the same ISBN, the method returns null.

      Parameters:
      title - the book's title
      author - the name of the author
      isbn - the book's ISBN identifier
      Returns:
      the newly added Book, or null if a duplicate ISBN exists
